text:
Situation: Fludarabine phosphate is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 15 vials of the 50 mg/2 mL presentation at 3.4 vials per day, giving 4.4 days on hand. Corvale General holds 82 vials at 4.5 vials per day, giving 18.2 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 6 vials at 6.3 days. The 25 mg/mL presentations are also stocked at each site.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2022-05-06, since resolved. FDA inspection 1142104 at NerPharMa S.r.l. ended 2020-01-17 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2021-05-19 — 840 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2022-05-06. A separate label for NDC 59923060402 names NerPharMa SRL (FEI 3004762406) as a registered manufacturing plant with a VAI inspection on 2024-09-13.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is below the desired buffer. Corvale General has sufficient supply to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks on hand. No active FDA shortage listing exists.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 vials of 50 mg/2 mL, 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — needs buyer approval.
3. Buy from Hisun Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. Buy from Lannett Company, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
5. Buy from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
